AccuracyPoint.description: One published actuals readout in the accuracy history.
AccuracyPoint.title: AccuracyPoint

ActualsAccuracy.description:
How close the model's predictions were to uploaded actuals (:func:`metrics_of`).

``mape`` and ``band_hit_rate`` are percentages (as ``compare.ts``); ``bias`` is the mean of
predicted − actual in KPI units (above 0: the model expected more).
ActualsAccuracy.title: ActualsAccuracy

BatchDownload.description: Whether ``…/readouts/{seq}/predictions.csv`` can be downloaded (by its owner).
BatchDownload.title: BatchDownload

BatchStats.description: The spread of the row centres of one output (never an interval).
BatchStats.title: BatchStats

ChannelReadout.description:
One channel row of the scorecard (``roi`` per unit of spend, ``mroi`` at the margin).

``spend`` and ``contribution`` are per readout period (the response grid's window totals
divided by its ``periods``), like the KPI tiles.
ChannelReadout.title: ChannelReadout

ClassAccuracy.description:
How right a classifier was (``threshold`` and ``positive`` for a binary one;
``rate_pred``/``rate_obs`` the predicted and observed share of ``positive``).
ClassAccuracy.title: ClassAccuracy

ConfusionMatrix.description: ``counts[i][j]``: cases of actual class ``labels[i]`` predicted as ``labels[j]``.
ConfusionMatrix.title: ConfusionMatrix

EffectAccuracy.description: The updated effect of a causal model: Σ actual − the counterfactual, with its range.
EffectAccuracy.title: EffectAccuracy

ErrorAccuracy.description:
Errors of numeric predictions (``mape``, ``wape``, ``smape`` and ``band_hit_rate`` in
percent; ``bias`` = mean of predicted − actual).
ErrorAccuracy.title: ErrorAccuracy

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes. See :data:`ERROR_INFO` for HTTP status and titles.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

FieldBlock.description:
A 2-D field map (at most 64 × 64 cells, 8 frames). Without ``missing_code`` (blocks
built before v0.17.0's fix) code ``c`` maps to ``vmin + c / 255 * (vmax - vmin)``; with
it, the value codes are ``0`` … ``254`` and map to ``vmin + c / 254 * (vmax - vmin)``,
and ``missing_code`` (255) is a cell with no value (drawn transparent, left out of the
statistics). Values are on log10 when ``log``.
FieldBlock.title: FieldBlock

FieldFrame.description: One frame of a field: ``width * height`` uint8 codes (row-major), base64 encoded.
FieldFrame.title: FieldFrame

ForecastConditioning.description:
What a forecast was conditioned on: the fitted history, the supplied actuals and where
the forecast periods came from. ``parameters`` is always ``fitted``: conditioning never
re-estimates the model. ``message`` says the same in plain language.

examples.message: Forecast updated with 3 actuals (1961-01-01 to 1961-03-01) after the fitted history, which ends 1960-12-01; the model's parameters were not re-estimated. 8 periods forecast from 1961-04-01 to 1961-11-01.
Forecast from the end of the fitted history (1960-12-01); no actuals were supplied. 8 periods forecast from 1961-01-01 to 1961-08-01.

actuals_through.description: The latest actual over every series
actuals_through.title: Actuals Through

conditioned.description: Whether any supplied actual was used
conditioned.title: Conditioned

fit_end.description: The last period of the fitted history
fit_end.title: Fit End

series_conditioned.description: Series with at least one actual
series_conditioned.title: Series Conditioned

ForecastConditioning.title: ForecastConditioning

Issue.description: One problem found while validating a document, located by a JSON pointer.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the submitted document
pointer.title: Pointer

untrusted_text.description: User/plugin-originated text; render as text only
untrusted_text.title: Untrusted Text

Issue.title: Issue

KpiValue.description: One KPI tile: a value with its plain caption and the change against ``delta_basis``.

approximate.description: Layout 2: the value is a sum or mean of point predictions
approximate.title: Approximate

KpiValue.title: KpiValue

PredictionResult.description:
The result of scenario rows. ``band``: the kind of range (``outcome``: one new result;
``mean``: the average; ``none``).
PredictionResult.title: PredictionResult

PredictionValue.description:
One output of one scenario row: its centre and range (``label``/``probability``:
the most probable class of a classifier).
PredictionValue.title: PredictionValue

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem document with mapi extensions (``code``, ``errors``, ``untrusted_text``).
Problem.title: Problem

ReadoutSnapshot.description:
What a readout shows, built server-side and capped at :data:`MAX_READOUT_BYTES`.

``lead`` is one plain sentence; ``notes_plain`` are at most :data:`MAX_NOTES` plain notes;
``technical`` is shown behind the "Show technical notes" toggle. Raw arrays, plots and
summaries are never copied in: ``source_run_ids`` keep the provenance.
ReadoutSnapshot.title: ReadoutSnapshot

SeriesBlock.description: Lines or fans over time or categories (``split_at``: where the forecast starts).
SeriesBlock.title: SeriesBlock

SeriesConditioning.description:
What one series' forecast was conditioned on.

``series`` holds the series' labels on the target's other dims (empty for a single
series). ``origin`` is the last period the forecast starts from: the last actual, or the
end of the fitted history when the series has none.

missing.description: Empty periods between the fitted history and the last actual, filtered as missing observations (only models that accept missing targets)
missing.title: Missing

revised.description: Actuals inside the fitted range: they replaced the fitted values
revised.title: Revised

SeriesConditioning.title: SeriesConditioning

Severity.description: How bad an :class:`Issue` is. Only ``error`` blocks submission.
Severity.title: Severity

UnavailableBlock.description: A panel whose source was missing at materialise (one panel never fails a readout).
UnavailableBlock.title: UnavailableBlock

description: A readout with its snapshot (``None`` until ``ready``) or the problem that stopped it.

snapshot.lead: Media brought 4,210 orders this week. This is 3% more than the model expects.
notes_plain: The model was fitted on data to 18/10/2026.

tiles.caption: Each 1 EUR of media brought 2.40 EUR
tiles.label: Return on media

mine.description: Whether the caller made this readout (its own tried case, file or upload); set on the readout list and reads, null where the caller is not known
mine.title: Mine

title: Readout
